note: HBL's schedule of bank charges (1 July to 31 December 2026): the monthly service charge of 50 rupees on accounts averaging under 40,000 rupees exempts regular PLS saving accounts and conventional current accounts, so the conventional current account carries no fee for keeping it; per-transaction, cheque book and card charges aren't modelled. Read again 2026-10-30: a cheque returned for want of funds costs its drawer 1,000 rupees; the international debit card (MasterCard Standard, as Visa) is 3,000 rupees a year (the domestic PayPak card 2,000), takes 4% on purchases abroad and 4% at least 300 rupees on withdrawals abroad; a transfer to another bank through the app is free up to an accumulated 25,000 rupees a month and at most 0.1% or 200 rupees beyond it (written as free). Charges are before federal excise duty and sales tax unless stated. Not stated: interest (none on a current account), overdraft, HBL's own and other banks' ATMs at home, transfers abroad, what opening asks.
